name: processtask_step_change_create
label: Work Order Step and Change Creation Relationship Table
description: The table connects the steps of work orders with changes to facilitate queries related to process associations and reporting scenarios.

fields.name: processtask_step_id
fields.description: Step ID. This value must be unique in the database and is suitable for exact-match queries and duplicate detection.

fields.name: change_id
fields.description: Change ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: config
fields.description: Configuration information is set when a change is created.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the change_id field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_processtask_step_id
indexes.description: Unique index covering the processtask_step_id field, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
